formats.label: JPG
formats.description: The standard photo format: small files, universal support, lossy compression.

formats.label: PNG
formats.description: Lossless image format with full transparency support.

formats.label: WebP
formats.description: Modern web image format: smaller than JPG and PNG, supports transparency and animation.

formats.label: AVIF
formats.description: Next-generation image format with the best compression of any still-image format.

formats.label: GIF
formats.description: Classic format for simple graphics and short animations (256 colours).

formats.label: TIFF
formats.description: High-quality lossless format used in print and archiving.

formats.label: BMP
formats.description: Uncompressed Windows bitmap format; large files, maximum compatibility.

formats.label: HEIC
formats.description: The photo format iPhones use: half the size of JPG at the same quality.

formats.label: ICO
formats.description: Windows icon format holding several sizes in one file.

formats.label: TGA
formats.description: Truevision Targa: uncompressed raster format from games and video.

formats.label: CR2
formats.description: Canon RAW photo file with the sensor's unprocessed data.

formats.label: CR3
formats.description: Canon's newer RAW format (CR3), used by recent EOS cameras.

formats.label: NEF
formats.description: Nikon RAW photo file with the sensor's unprocessed data.

formats.label: ARW
formats.description: Sony RAW photo file with the sensor's unprocessed data.

formats.label: ORF
formats.description: Olympus / OM System RAW photo file.

formats.label: RAF
formats.description: Fujifilm RAW photo file with the sensor's unprocessed data.

formats.label: RW2
formats.description: Panasonic / Leica RAW photo file.

formats.label: DNG
formats.description: Adobe's open RAW format, used by many cameras and phones.

formats.label: PEF
formats.description: Pentax RAW photo file with the sensor's unprocessed data.

formats.label: MP3
formats.description: The universal audio format: plays everywhere, small files.

formats.label: WAV
formats.description: Uncompressed CD-quality audio; large files, studio standard.

formats.label: FLAC
formats.description: Lossless audio compression: perfect quality at about half the size of WAV.

formats.label: OGG
formats.description: Open audio container, usually with Vorbis audio.

formats.label: M4A
formats.description: Apple's audio format (AAC in an MP4 container).

formats.label: AAC
formats.description: Efficient compressed audio; the standard for streaming and mobile.

formats.label: Opus
formats.description: Open, low-latency codec that sounds great even at very low bitrates.

formats.label: AIFF
formats.description: Apple's uncompressed audio format, the Mac equivalent of WAV.

formats.label: WMA
formats.description: Windows Media Audio, Microsoft's compressed audio format.

formats.label: MP4
formats.description: The universal video format: plays on every phone, browser and TV.

formats.label: MKV
formats.description: Flexible open video container that holds many audio and subtitle tracks.

formats.label: MOV
formats.description: Apple QuickTime video format, common from iPhones and Final Cut.

formats.label: AVI
formats.description: Classic Windows video container; large files, wide compatibility.

formats.label: WebM
formats.description: Open web video format built for browsers (VP8/VP9 + Opus).

formats.label: WMV
formats.description: Windows Media Video, Microsoft's video format.

formats.label: M4V
formats.description: Apple's video format, near-identical to MP4.

formats.label: 3GP
formats.description: Mobile video format from early phones; tiny files, low resolution.

formats.label: PSD
formats.description: Adobe Photoshop document. Conversion uses the flattened composite image; layers are not preserved.
uses: Sharing a preview of a design

formats.label: SVG
formats.description: Scalable vector graphic: infinitely sharp at any size, defined as text.

formats.label: PDF
formats.description: Portable Document Format: the standard for sharing documents and scans.

image.label: Quality
image.hint: Higher quality means a larger file. Recommended: JPG 85, WebP 80, AVIF 60.

image.label: Max width (px)
image.hint: Leave empty to keep the original width.

image.label: Max height (px)
image.hint: Leave empty to keep the original height.

image.label: Resolution
image.hint: Downscale the longest side to a preset size.

image.label: Background colour
image.hint: Transparency is flattened onto this colour when the target (JPG, BMP) has no transparency.

image.label: Strip metadata
image.hint: Removes location (GPS) and other metadata. Turn off to keep it.

audio.label: Bitrate
audio.hint: Recommended: 192 kbps for MP3 and M4A.

audio.label: Sample rate
audio.hint: Kept from the source by default, capped at 48 kHz.

audio.label: Channels
audio.hint: Keep the source channels, or force stereo or mono.

video.label: Quality (CRF)
video.hint: Lower is better quality and a larger file. Recommended: MP4 23, WebM 32.

video.label: Encoding preset
video.hint: Slower presets compress better but take longer.

video.label: Resolution
video.hint: Downscale the video to a preset height.

video.label: Trim start (seconds)
video.hint: Start the output at this time.

video.label: Trim end (seconds)
video.hint: End the output at this time.

pdf.label: Render DPI
pdf.hint: Higher DPI means sharper images and larger files. Range 72-300.

pdf.label: Page range
pdf.hint: For example 1-3 or 2,5. Leave empty for all pages (50-page cap).

trace.label: Trace preset
trace.hint: Logo: clean shapes. Photo: detailed. Line art: thin strokes.
